scenes.line1: How does SQL keep your data safe?
scenes.say: Ever wonder how SQL protects your data, and what can mess it up? Let’s break down the essentials.

scenes.label: ACID
scenes.say: ACID is the foundation: atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability. Each keeps your data reliable and safe.
Isolation levels control what data you see and how transactions interact. Higher levels mean more safety, but less speed.

scenes.question: How can you prevent deadlocks?
scenes.wrong: Always use the highest isolation level.
scenes.right: Keep transactions short and access resources in a consistent order. Use lower isolation levels when possible.
scenes.say: Deadlocks happen when transactions block each other. Interviewers love to ask how you prevent them—so don’t just say higher isolation. Keep transactions short and consistent.
